tasks.label: Build scheduler module
tasks.detail: Optimised, with debug symbols (RelWithDebInfo). Use this for experiments.
args: cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo -DPYTHON_EXECUTABLE=$(which python3) && cmake --build build --target scheduler

tasks.label: Build scheduler module (Debug, unoptimised)
tasks.detail: For stepping through the C++ in gdb. Many times slower: rebuild with the task above afterwards.
args: cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DPYTHON_EXECUTABLE=$(which python3) && cmake --build build --target scheduler
